about: Real updates to Shotclock's library: what the watcher flagged, what a person found, and what changed. Newest first.

entries.source: San Clemente Municipal Code § 17.28.270 (Accessory Dwelling Units)
entries.flag: Watcher: the code site blocks automated checks; check it in a browser.
entries.found: The city amended § 17.28.270 by Ord. No. 1810 on June 16, 2026, eight months after HCD's Oct 2025 findings letter. Checked against HCD's 10 findings, the new text appears to fix all 10: it cites §§ 66310–66342, allows unit combinations and up to 8 detached ADUs on existing multifamily lots, allows 18 ft near transit, limits owner occupancy and deed restrictions to JADUs, drops the 'sanctioned, posted' car-share condition, guarantees 800 sq ft, drops 'match the primary dwelling', and covers unpermitted units built before 2020. One stale citation remains: the JADU sale clause still cites deleted § 65852.26.
